reason: ₱1,800 is a lot for me, almost what I'd spend on my whole outfit for the debut. I can get gel with simple art at our parlor for ₱500 to ₱700, and there are home-service nail pages on Facebook that charge way less, so I'd compare those first.
objection: I don't know if their gel will last as long as salon gel, and I've never seen their work or reviews, so ₱1,800 feels risky for a new page.
would_change_my_mind: A first-time or event promo around ₱1,000 with real customer photos showing the nails still intact after two or three weeks.
